newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain car sales up 19.8% in April - Anfac.
newsitem.headline: Spain car sales up 19.8% in April - Anfac.

text.p: Spanish car sales in April totalled 89,334 units, a rise of 19.80 percent versus the same month in 1996, provisional data from carmakers' association Anfac showed on Tuesday.
In the first four months, total car sales reached 328,183 units, 9.47 percent up from the year-ago period.
Anfac added during the month both new aid scheme and Easter holidays boosted sales.
Earlier on Tuesday Industry Ministry Josep Pique said demand for cars in April rose more than 20 percent, boosted by a recently-approved car aid scheme.
The Structural Programme for the Renovation of Vehicles, (PREVER) was approved on April 4 and provides subsidies to replace vehicles which are over 10 years old with new ones.
